title: Support-controlled stationary pages for filtered resolution pullback
statement: For each scheme X [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and bounded-below complex K of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], choose termwise hypercohomology presentations D(X,K) [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. For a scheme morphism f:Y→X and a complex map v:f⁻¹K→L [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], choose spectral-sequence maps M [def-sp-spectral-sequence] with the first-page equation H(v) after cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Call page r support-admissible for (K,q,n) if there exists a lower bound a with K^s zero for s<a and max(1,q-a+2,n-q+2)≤r. For every admissible r≥1 choose isomorphisms eInf:E_r(q,n-q)≅gr^q D(X,K).H_n. For every supplied map j between the chosen K-injective resolutions [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions] extending v up to homotopy and every chain map w of their global sections given degreewise by the inverse-image unit followed by Γ(j), there are maps t_q of the abutment filtration steps commuting with inclusions and the conjugate e_ρX⁻¹ H^n(w) e_ρY [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. For every proof hc of compatibility with successive step inclusions, whenever r is support-admissible for source and target, the M-page map under eInf equals cokernel.map(t_(q+1),t_q,hc). No integer threshold, canonical derived unit-Leray identification, identity law or composition law is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 13.21.3; Remark 13.21.4, Tag 015K; support argument in the proof of Lemma 59.52.1, Tag 0EZM

proof.text: Choose D, M and eInf jointly from the support-controlled augmented CE-total construction. Retain its first-page equation, strict augmentation square and stationary comparison for the same chosen total map u. No arbitrary presentation or stationary isomorphism is substituted.

For a supplied resolution lift j, let g be u followed by the target comparison. The strict augmentation square and over_K give the homotopy hg. The source augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism. Exact inverse image preserves it. Both g and inverse image of the source comparison followed by j extend v up to homotopy. Injectivity of precomposition into the target K-injective resolution therefore equates their homotopy classes.

Apply global sections to the homotopy and precompose with the sections unit and totalSectionsIso. Naturality of the unit and totalSectionsIso_comparison identify the other endpoint with the presentation w_X followed by the supplied w. Homotopy.homologyMap_eq gives hGamma. Postcomposition functoriality of ceSectionsLift identifies the chosen CE-total map followed by w_Y with totalSectionsIso_X.hom followed by ceSectionsLift(f,g).

Use c_formula and homologyMap_comp. Cancel the source resolution comparison to obtain hconj: the CE-total abutment map is exactly the conjugate of homologyMap w by the two resolutionEtaleCohomologyIso maps. Keep the same t and rewrite its inclusion equation using habut and hconj. The stationary-page equation is unchanged because it depends on t and hc, not on the proof ht.

theorem exists_etaleHypercohomology_supported_resolution_maps :
    ∃ (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (M : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
        (D X K).sequence ⟶ (D Y L).sequence)
      (eInf : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (q n r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hR : ∃ a : ℤ, (∀ s : ℤ, s < a → IsZero (K.obj.X s)) ∧
          max 1 (max (q - a + 2) (n - q + 2)) ≤ r),
        ((D X K).sequence.page r hr).X (q, n - q) ≅ ((D X K).H n).gradedPiece q),
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj) (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
        ((M f K L v).hom 1).f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ ((D Y L).firstPageIso p q).hom =
          ((D X K).firstPageIso p q).hom ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Sheaf.H.map (v.f q) p).comp
              (cohomologyMap f (K.obj.X q) p))) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj) (n : ℤ),
        ∀ (j : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (D X K).ρ.complex ⟶ (D Y L).ρ.complex)
          (hj : Nonempty (Homotopy
            (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (D X K).ρ.map ≫ j) (v ≫ (D Y L).ρ.map))),
        ∀ (w : ((Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (D X K).ρ.complex ⟶
            ((Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (D Y L).ρ.complex)
          (hw : ∀ i : ℤ, w.f i =
            globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f ((D X K).ρ.complex.X i) ≫
              (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map (j.f i)),
        ∃ (t : ∀ q : ℤ, (((D X K).H n).step q : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⟶
            (((D Y L).H n).step q : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
          (ht : ∀ q : ℤ, t q ≫ (((D Y L).H n).step q).arrow =
            (((D X K).H n).step q).arrow ≫
            ((@resolutionEtaleCohomologyIso.{u} X K.obj (D X K).ρ.complex
              (D X K).ρ.map (D X K).ρ.quasiIso (D X K).ρ.isKInjective n).inv ≫
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap w n ≫
            (@resolutionEtaleCohomologyIso.{u} Y L.obj (D Y L).ρ.complex
              (D Y L).ρ.map (D Y L).ρ.quasiIso (D Y L).ρ.isKInjective n).hom)),
          ∀ (hc : ∀ q : ℤ,
            Subobject.ofLE (((D X K).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D X K).H n).step q)
                (((D X K).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))) ≫ t q =
              t (q + 1) ≫
                Subobject.ofLE (((D Y L).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D Y L).H n).step q)
                  (((D Y L).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q)))),
          ∀ (q r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hX : ∃ a : ℤ, (∀ s : ℤ, s < a → IsZero (K.obj.X s)) ∧
          max 1 (max (q - a + 2) (n - q + 2)) ≤ r)
          (hY : ∃ a : ℤ, (∀ s : ℤ, s < a → IsZero (L.obj.X s)) ∧
          max 1 (max (q - a + 2) (n - q + 2)) ≤ r),
            ((M f K L v).hom r hr).f (q, n - q) ≫ (eInf Y L q n r hr hY).hom =
              (eInf X K q n r hr hX).hom ≫
                cokernel.map
                  (Subobject.ofLE (((D X K).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D X K).H n).step q)
                    (((D X K).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))))
                  (Subobject.ofLE (((D Y L).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D Y L).H n).step q)
                    (((D Y L).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))))
                  (t (q + 1)) (t q) (hc q))
